question: In which of the following years was the first cotton textile mill established in Bombay?
solution:
The correct answer is** __1854__**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****

__
 
• The first cotton textile mill was established by** Kawasji Dhabar in Bombay on 7th July 1854.**
 
• **India enjoyed a monopoly** in the production of **cotton textiles from 1500 BC to 1500 AD**.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• India has the largest land area under cotton cultivation in the world.
 
• **In India cotton has suitable temp, rainfall and soil for its growth.**
 
• **Cotton is cultivated in Black soil **also known as** Cotton soil or Regur soil.**
 
• The region of the Deccan plateau consisted of** Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Gujarat and Chhattisgarh are the major producers of cotton.**
 
• The two World Wars were fought in Europe, as India was a British colony.​
 
• There was a demand for cloth in Britain hence, they gave a boost to the development of cotton textile in India.
